text:
🔥🇲🇽 <u>"They're not people, they're robots"</u>

Sheinbaum named the machinery behind the manufactured outrage against her government: conservative money running AI bots that fake millions of views and trending smears — the same networks that pushed "narcopresidente" and "narcogobierno" during the campaign. "No son personas, son robots," she said, calling for rules so platforms can't let algorithms drown out real citizens.

🇲🇽📚 <u>Veracruz opens nine new public high schools</u>

With federal resources, Veracruz will build nine new "Margarita Maza" high schools across the state — plus two special-education centers in the Indigenous Sierra de Zongolica and a Teletón rehabilitation center in Minatitlán. "The president gave the resources to open nine prepas... schools that go to the whole state," said Governor Rocío Nahle.

🇲🇽📈 <u>Mexico grew triple the OECD average</u>

Mexico's economy expanded 1.5% in the second quarter — the sixth-fastest in the entire OECD and three times the bloc's 0.5% average, ahead of the United States. After the "stagnant Mexico" headlines, the country rebounded from a weak Q1 and outpaced almost the whole rich world, trailing only Ireland (3.9%) and Israel (3.6%).

🇲🇽🌎 <u>Mexico won't flinch at the US-Canada tariff war</u>

Washington just hit Canada with 50% auto tariffs, but Sheinbaum says the "desencuentro" won't touch Mexico's economy. Economy Secretary Marcelo Ebrard is in Washington all week, and Mexican exports to the US keep climbing — powered by an AI-driven electronics boom the US isn't tariffing. "We don't want those electronics to just pass through Mexican territory with no added value," she said.

‍NEWSWEEK: Mexico Turns to Unusual Tactic in Growing Fight Over ICE Deaths August 20, 2026 | 🟡 📰 Mexico pressing for answers on 17 nationals dead in ICE custody or during operations gets filed under "unusual tactic." 🇲🇽 14 died in detention or after medical transfer. "Each case has behind it a Mexican family that deserves truth and justice." Mexico is working county-level and diplomatic channels because federal ones went nowhere — a demand for accountability the piece frames as "a notable escalation." • "each case has behind it a Mexican family that deserves truth and justice" • Framed as "a notable escalation in how foreign governments respond" • Sheinbaum "vocal in her disappointment"

text: ‍FOX CAROLINA: 31 indicted in "Operation Last Stand" cartel pipeline to Charleston August 24, 2026 | 🔴 📰 South Carolina's AG announces "Operation Last Stand" — 31 indicted for moving cocaine, fentanyl and meth from Mexico into the Charleston area. 🔍 The case grew out of a nightclub raid that produced 86 arrests — 79 of them immigration-related. Drug trafficking and immigration status get welded into a single "cartel pipeline" headline; the 79 immigration arrests are counted as part of the same operation aimed at "the southern border." • AG targeted "cartel- and gang-linked organizations" • "hundreds of kilograms... through routes connected to the southern border" • Nightclub raid yielded "86 arrests, including 79 immigration-related"
banner: Nightclub raid rebranded as cartel pipeline

text: ‍BLOOMBERG: Mexico GDP Bounces Back in Second Quarter Despite Trade Stress August 24, 2026 | 🟡 📰 Mexico's economy grew 1.4% in Q2 — its fastest pace since 2022 — on record exports and construction. Bloomberg's word for it: "despite." 🇲🇽 The economy Trump's tariffs were supposed to break keeps beating estimates. Final INEGI figures confirmed the rebound was built on services, construction and record exports even as US tariff friction continues — a result the headline leads with as a caveat, not an achievement. • Headline hedge: "Despite Trade Stress" • "rebounded... after exports rose to a record" • "fastest growing pace since 2022"

‍REUTERS: Sheinbaum says governor's return was "not appropriate" August 24, 2026 | 🟡 📰 Sinaloa's governor tried to reclaim his post after US cartel charges — Sheinbaum and his own party forced him back out in 34 hours. 🇲🇽 "No personal interest can ever come before the interests of the people and the nation." US prosecutors charged Rocha in April on conspiracy and bribery tied to the Sinaloa Cartel; Mexico has asked to see the evidence and insists on prosecuting at home rather than extraditing on informant claims. • "No personal interest can ever come before the interests of the people and the nation" • Sheinbaum: "I had no prior knowledge that he wanted to return" • The return, called "reckless" and "not appropriate"

🇲🇽🏭 <u>FOREIGN DIRECT INVESTMENT HITS RECORD $34.97B IN H1 2026</u>

Mexico pulled in $34.968 billion in foreign direct investment in the first half of 2026 — the highest first-half total ever recorded, per Secretaría de Economía data reported by El Financiero. FDI has nearly doubled (+89.7%) since 2021, with Mexico City alone taking 48% of the total, even as Trump wages a tariff war.

🔥🇲🇽 <u>IMSS CANCELS GRUPO SALINAS CONTRACTS OVER DATA BREACH</u>

IMSS canceled two contracts with companies tied to Ricardo Salinas Pliego's Grupo Salinas after they passed the institute's confidential provider database to a third party without authorization. President Sheinbaum ordered the case reviewed and the Órgano Interno de Control opened an investigation into whether officials were complicit — the same conglomerate whose owner still owes the state billions in back taxes.
